analysis_plan.primary: Delta-prompt minus matched_checklist accuracy, separately in each of two prespecified models
analysis_plan.unit: normalized source; retain its valid/invalid pair and all six model-condition outcomes per candidate
analysis_plan.point_weighting: micro-average across candidates; equals equal-source macro-average because each source has exactly one row per label
analysis_plan.bootstrap: unstratified paired source resampling with replacement; same source indices across all models/conditions/metrics
analysis_plan.randomization: two-sided whole-source method-label swaps for accuracy; fixed common sign vector per draw; plus-one Monte Carlo p
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two prespecified model primary accuracy p-values only; secondary contrasts exploratory/unadjusted; no pooled cross-model test
analysis_plan.development_status: Test protocol must have been frozen before these responses; no outcome-based method selection.
analysis_plan.interval_scope: conditional descriptive source-cluster intervals for selected source sample; no domain-level generalization, multiplicity-adjusted CI, or randomized causal claim
analysis_plan.cost_scope: all recorded calls; output tokens exclude EOS by collection contract; unknown usage stays unknown, with known lower bounds
analysis_plan.label_policy: Original benchmark labels only; label-review flags never used to rescore
